caption:
Try counting your blessings before breakfast

Allah says that if you try to count His favors, you will not be able to enumerate them. And He is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful. Start the day by noticing a few of them.

Surah An-Nahl 16:18

Name three blessings you woke up with today

#gratitude #shukr #countyourblessings #quranreels

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
